title: GitHub Copilot Integration Final Test — Modern Responsive Dashboard
description: A modern, responsive Dashboard layout with a collapsible Sidebar, a Topbar with user controls, and three Stat Cards (Total Users, Revenue, Active Sessions).

components.name: NavItem
components.description: A single navigation link item used inside the Sidebar, supports active and hover states.

label.description: Display text for the nav link

icon.description: Icon element rendered before the label

isActive.description: Highlights item when current route matches

layout.tailwind: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors duration-150 cursor-pointer

components.name: StatCard
components.description: A metric card displaying a stat title, numeric value, percentage trend badge, and a contextual icon. Used in groups of three on the Dashboard.

trend.description: Percentage change vs previous period (positive = up, negative = down)

icon.description: Contextual icon for the metric type

iconBgColor.description: Tailwind bg class for icon container, e.g. 'bg-indigo-100'

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-3 p-6 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100

children.tailwind: w-10 h-10 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl
children.description: Icon container with dynamic bg color

children.tailwind: inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-1 rounded-full
children.description: Trend badge — green for positive, red for negative

components.name: StatCardSkeleton
components.description: Placeholder skeleton card shown while StatCard data is loading.

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-3 p-6 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 animate-pulse

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: Vertical navigation sidebar fixed on the left. Collapses to icon-only mode on mobile. Contains the app logo/brand, primary nav links, and a bottom user profile snippet.

isOpen.description: Controls expanded vs. collapsed state on mobile

onClose.description: Callback to close the mobile drawer overlay

navItems.description: Array of nav item configs { label, icon, href, isActive }

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col w-64 h-screen bg-slate-800 text-white fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-40 transition-transform duration-300

responsiveBehavior.mobile: Rendered as an off-canvas drawer; translates off-screen when closed (-translate-x-full), overlaid with a semi-transparent backdrop
responsiveBehavior.desktop: Always visible, static positioned as part of the two-column layout

children.tailwind: flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-5 border-b border-slate-700
w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-indigo-500 flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold text-sm
px-4 py-4 border-t border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-3
w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-indigo-400 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold

components.name: MobileMenuButton
components.description: Hamburger / close toggle button visible only on mobile to open/close the Sidebar drawer.

layout.tailwind: flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 rounded-lg text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors md:hidden

components.name: SearchBar
components.description: Inline search input in the Topbar for global search across the dashboard.

onSearch.description: Callback fired on input change or submit

layout.tailwind: flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 w-full max-w-xs

children.tailwind: bg-transparent text-sm text-slate-700 placeholder-slate-400 outline-none w-full

components.name: NotificationBell
components.description: Icon button in the Topbar showing unread notification count badge.

count.description: Number of unread notifications; hides badge when 0

layout.tailwind: relative flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 rounded-lg text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors

children.tailwind: absolute top-1 right-1 w-2 h-2 bg-red-500 rounded-full ring-2 ring-white

components.name: UserMenu
components.description: Clickable avatar in the Topbar that opens a dropdown menu with profile and logout actions.

userName.description: Display name of the current user

avatarUrl.description: URL of the user avatar image; falls back to initials

children.tailwind: w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden
absolute right-0 top-10 mt-1 w-48 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-lg border border-slate-100 py-1 z-50
block px-4 py-2 text-sm text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50
block px-4 py-2 text-sm text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50
block px-4 py-2 text-sm text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50

components.name: Topbar
components.description: Horizontal top navigation bar fixed at the top of the main content area. Contains the mobile menu toggle, page title, search bar, notification bell, and user menu.

pageTitle.description: Current page heading displayed in the Topbar

layout.tailwind: flex items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 sm:px-6 py-3 bg-white border-b border-slate-100 sticky top-0 z-30

components.name: StatCardGrid
components.description: Responsive three-column grid of StatCards for Total Users, Revenue, and Active Sessions.

stats.description: Array of stat data objects passed to each StatCard

layout.tailwind: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4 sm:gap-6

components.name: DashboardContent
components.description: Scrollable main content area rendered to the right of the Sidebar. Hosts the Topbar and all page-level sections.

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col flex-1 min-h-screen bg-slate-50 overflow-y-auto

components.name: SidebarBackdrop
components.description: Semi-transparent overlay rendered behind the mobile Sidebar drawer to dismiss it on tap.

layout.tailwind: fixed inset-0 z-30 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm transition-opacity duration-300 md:hidden

components.name: DashboardPage
components.description: Root page component that composes the full Dashboard layout: Sidebar, SidebarBackdrop, and DashboardContent side by side.

initialStats.description: Server-side pre-fetched stat data for SSR/SSG scenarios

interactions.action: Toggles the Sidebar drawer open/closed on mobile; animates with translate-x transition
Navigates to the target route; updates active state styling
Opens a notification panel or dropdown listing recent alerts
Toggles the user dropdown menu; closes on outside click
Filters dashboard content or navigates to search results in real-time
At md breakpoint Sidebar transitions from drawer to static; Topbar adapts right-side controls
Renders StatCardSkeleton placeholders while fetching data, then swaps in StatCards
